# REMAINING WORK — Every Geelooy Page

The Awtsmoos renews every route each instant; Awtsmoos.com must make every public vessel clear, fast, usable, accessible, truthful, and alive.

## Mission

Improve every actual public page under `geelooy`: hierarchy, responsiveness, accessibility, interactions, runtime correctness, loading speed, discoverability, error states, browser behavior, games, editors, search/social flows, maintainability, compact transport where measured, publication, deployment, and production verification.

## Gates

- Inventory and classify every real public route; exclude fixtures/templates by evidence.
- Run the existing runtime/browser audit over the complete route set.
- Record console/network/MIME/overflow/focus/touch/rendering/performance findings.
- Merge findings with active agent ownership so concurrent work is never overwritten.
- Repair every safe clean/unclaimed broken family with complete-file rewrites.
- Verify games are playable and editors actually initialize/respond.
- Verify search/social/content flows end to end.
- Measure cold/warm loading and transferred resources.
- Trace `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer` compact behavior before using `compact=true`.
- Keep readable source; compact only transport where measured beneficial.
- Keep every touched source <=120 lines, tabs for indentation, no minification.
- Read back every production write and resolve planned-vs-actual deltas.
- Secret/risk-scan entire repository before the requested full Git snapshot.
- Push the complete safe repository state, including unrelated requested changes.
- Execute the actual deploy mechanism and smoke production.

## Immediate Work

1. Close Sefarim readback/tests/browser/performance gate.
2. Harvest the lightweight route census and runtime-audit usage.
3. Discover active claims and rank clean route families.
4. Run the full public-route matrix.
5. Repair highest-impact unowned family, verify, rerun matrix, continue.

## NEXT_ACTION

Write the three planning waves, then harvest currently running verification/discovery receipts and execute the first safe ranked action.
